text:
Ana: quick ask — can someone kick off a cb saturation run for the combo: max_batch=64, max_tokens=1024, cb_window=50? saw tail latency jump on canary this morning :eyes:
Raj: I can run it, but what load profile do you want? steady RPS or spikes?
Ana: start with steady 600 RPS for 10m, then a 2m spike to 1200 RPS. capture per-token latency, queue depth, and drop count. include KV cache warm/cold phases.
Raj: got it. running from staging-gpu-2 now. tagging run cb_saturation_2026-raj. will post perf-bot link when finished.
perf-bot: scheduled run cb_saturation_2026-raj on staging-gpu-2. config: {"max_batch":64,"max_tokens":1024,"cb_window":50,"profile":"steady_then_spike"}. estimated duration 12m.
Maria: heads-up — if the GPU memory hits 92% the autoscaler will start moving other workloads. please set cc to eng-runtime if you hit that so infra doesn't evict.
Raj: noted. will set an alert and run with isolation flag: --no-burst.
Tim: FYI, the canary regression we saw had a small queuing tail at sequence len 512+ — might be related to the new batching heuristic that increases CB window when CPU load low. recommend instrumenting queue wait histograms.
Judy: adding to checklist: 
- include queue_wait_histogram (p50/90/99)
- collect prefix_cache_hit_rate
- sample a few responses for quality regressions

Raj: running loadgen command: 
```
./loadgen --rps 600 --duration 600 --spike 1200,120 --model rdx-3b-quant --tags cb_saturation_2026-raj --collect queue_wait_histogram,prefix_cache_hit_rate
```

ops-bot: loadgen job started on staging-gpu-2 (job id: 2026-987). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/2026-987

Maria: quick thought — please ensure sample prompts include both short (32 tokens) and long (900 tokens) to exercise kv-cache.
Raj: sampling set attached to job. starting steady phase now.
perf-bot: steady phase complete. uploaded metrics to https://perf.redwood.dev/runs/2026-987. preliminary p99 per-token latency = 0.023s (normal), p99 queue_wait = 120ms (elevated).
Ana: thanks. can you paste the tail latency timeline? want to see when the spike aligned with queue depth.
Raj: pasting condensed log excerpt:
```
[00:04] RPS 600 - queue_depth p99=3, p99_wait=18ms, per_token_p99=0.021s
[08:31] transition spike - queue_depth p99=24, p99_wait=190ms, per_token_p99=0.034s
[09:02] spike peak - RPS 1200 - queue_depth p99=46, p99_wait=420ms, per_token_p99=0.058s
[10:15] post-spike - queue_depth p99=8, p99_wait=60ms, per_token_p99=0.025s
```
Judy: looks like the batching heuristic increased CB window during the steady phase and then couldn't keep up when the spike hit. We should fail-safe to max_batch=32 if queue_wait > 200ms.
Tim: agree. new quick patch idea: on queue_wait p99 > 150ms, decay cb_window by 0.5x and disable burst growth for 30s. low-risk and easy to roll back.
Ana: sounds reasonable. Raj — can you run an A/B where we force max_batch=32 and the decay rule, and compare run metrics? small 6m test should show effect.
Raj: starting ab test now: run A = baseline (current heuristic), run B = forced max_batch=32 + decay rule. both same load profile but 6m each. tagging cb_saturation_2026-ab.

perf-bot: A/B scheduled; run ids 2026-988 (A) and 2026-989 (B).

perf-bot: run A complete. p99 per-token=0.056s, p99 queue_wait=410ms.
perf-bot: run B complete. p99 per-token=0.038s, p99 queue_wait=140ms.

Maria: that's promising. any impact on throughput? dropped requests?
Raj: no drops in B, throughput sustained. CPU slightly higher but within headroom.
Judy: can we add a short circuit: if decay rule triggers >3x in 5m, send alert and cap to conservative policy (max_batch=16) until manual ack.
Tim: SGTM. also add a metric for heuristic_decay_events.

Ana: next steps:
- Raj: open PR with the decay rule + instrumentation + unit test for window decay logic
- Maria: add run tags and save perf artifacts under /artifacts/cb_saturation/2026-raj
- Judy: update runbook with the new alert threshold and conservative cap

Raj: will open PR in ~30m. PR will reference perf run 2026-989 and include the loadgen commands.

Judy: thanks. leaving a quick note in runbook: "if queue_wait p99 >200ms, engage decay; if decay triggers >3x in 5m, escalate to oncall and cap to max_batch=16" :white_check_mark:

Ana: awesome, thanks everyone. marking this thread resolved for now. ping if regressions reappear. :thumbsup:
